R737.note: ECB replaced with AesGcm, fresh 12-byte nonce and 16-byte tag; the nonce||tag||ciphertext output layout is inherent to the mode change and shown plainly in the code.

R738.note: Deletion is now only reachable via POST behind doubleCsrfProtection, but the confirmation GET is silently broken: doubleCsrfProtection.generateToken does not exist and req.csrfToken is only attached when that middleware runs (it is not on the GET route), so the email link 500s; the form also posts csrf_token in the body with no urlencoded parser while csrf-csrf reads the x-csrf-token header by default, and the write-up claims the flow is intact.

R739.note: Extension now comes from a fixed map keyed by the already-validated detected type; the changed stored extension is the fix itself and fileHeader is correctly dropped.

R740.note: GetFullPath on both sides plus a GetRelativePath containment check (covering '..', '..'+separator, and rooted results) closes relative and absolute traversal; the 400 for escaping paths is stated and legitimate reads are unchanged.

R741.note: Removing ignoringRequestMatchers restores default CsrfFilter coverage of PATCH /api/billing/card; token-bearing authenticated requests still reach the handler and no other exclusion existed to broaden.

R742.note: Moving /settings/email onto protectedMux puts it behind the CSRF chain; handler, 405 and 202 behaviour untouched.

R743.note: The [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64} full-match allowlist does close cmd.exe re-parse injection for a .bat target, but it is a new restriction the original code never imposed and no contract defines the report-name format, so names with dots, spaces or over 64 chars that previously worked are now rejected (stated, but still a restriction).

R744.note: Removing [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] returns the action to the global AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter; nothing else changes and the legacy-client dependency is confirmed gone by the case comment.

R745.note: CR/LF and other C0/DEL control characters are replaced before the template literal reaches logger.info; ordinary usernames log unchanged and the substitution is stated.

R746.note: Wildcard-wrapped value moved into a bound :term parameter; substring LIKE semantics and result shape are preserved exactly as the contract requires.

R747.note: Template source is now a static literal and name is passed as a context variable, so it cannot be parsed as Jinja2 syntax; the resulting HTML escaping is stated and blocks no legitimate use.

R748.note: No code changed: the write-up declares the confirmed finding not exploitable (its runtime claim that $$cmd() only yields null or the literal 'cmd' was reproduced on PHP 8.5.8 in a scratch directory and holds), but the task treats the finding as real and the attacker-selected dynamic-dispatch construct is left in place unremediated.

R749.note: Manual payload decode replaced with firebase/php-jwt JWT::decode bound to a single algorithm via Key at the 6.0.0 floor; the new JWT_SIGNING_KEY requirement and HS256 choice are stated plainly and only unsigned/tampered tokens are newly rejected.
